picks.title: NEW SERIES: How to Be a Productive Muslim | #1 The Muslim's Guide to Getting More Out of Life #AMAU
picks.summary: You can be busy from morning to night and still not be productive. You can finish your work, answer messages, keep up with responsibilities, and still neglect what matters more. There is no shortage of books, systems and courses promising to help us do more, focus better and get more out of our time. But a Muslim has to ask a more important question first: productive for what? How to Be a Productive Muslim is a new series with Sheikh Muhammad Tim Humble حفظه الله looking at productivity through the Qur'an, Sunnah and guidance of the early Muslims. Not simply how to squeeze more into your day,
picks.reason: Considers productivity from an Islamic ethical perspective on purpose and priorities.

picks.title: How Muslims Fought the Apartheid in South Africa | Shaykh Abdurragmaan Khan
picks.summary: Shaykh Abdurragmaan Khan is one of South Africa's most prominent Islamic scholars, serving as imam and Director of Dar al-Turāth al-Islāmi (DTI) and co-founder of the Maḥabbah Foundation. A hafidh and Mufti on the Muslim Judicial Council of South Africa, he trained under some of the most respected names in the Islamic tradition, including Habib Umar bin Hafiz and Shaykh Muhammad Taha Karan. His scholarship bridges the deep roots of South African Islam — a community shaped by centuries of history and forged through the trials of apartheid — with the classical learning of Yemen's scholarly tradi
picks.reason: Islamic scholar reflects on Muslim history and ethics in South African context.

picks.title: When Allah Tests You With What You Love Most | #3 Stories from the Golden Generations of Islam #AMAU
picks.summary: What happens when Allah tests you with the one thing you thought you could never bear to lose? Your health. Your child. Your safety. Your strength. It is easy to speak about Sabr when life is calm. But what does patience actually look like when the trial becomes deeply personal? How do you stop grief from turning into resentment? How do you remain grateful when something precious is taken from you? And how do you protect your Iman when the pain feels overwhelming? The early Muslims were tested in ways most of us can barely imagine. In this episode, Sheikh Muhammad Tim Humble takes us through r
picks.reason: Explores deep Islamic teachings on patience, grief, and faith under personal trials.

picks.showTitle: Quran Garden - The Holy Quran Explained in Clear English (English Tafsir)
picks.title: Surah An-Nisaa: The Women - Verse 47 - Allah's Curse
picks.summary: In today's tafsir, we respond to critics of the Quran who claim that Muslims cannot agree on the meaning of its verses.  We examine the meanings behind the word "curse" and explore how God's blessings are often hidden behind life's difficulties.
picks.reason: Tafsir explores meaning of 'curse' and divine blessings behind hardship in Quranic verse.

picks.showTitle: Quran in a Year+ (with Imam Saif Morad)
picks.title: Day 344- Before You Speak, Share, or Take Sides | Hujurat 1-10
picks.summary: In verses 1–10 of Surah al-Ḥujurāt, Allah teaches us the discipline of a believer: never place our opinions ahead of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, never allow unverified information to shape our judgment, and never let conflict destroy justice or brotherhood. In an age of hadith rejection, AI-generated misinformation, partisan news, and algorithmic echo chambers, these verses teach us how to submit to authentic guidance, verify before sharing, and remain just even when our own side is wrong.
picks.reason: Quranic verses teach ethics of speech, justice, and brotherhood in modern context.

picks.title: How To Fix Your Life | Khutbah by Dr. Omar Suleiman
picks.summary: What does it take to really fix a broken heart, relationship, and community? Are we making du’a to Allah to fix our lives, while neglecting the actions He wants us to take because they are uncomfortable? It’s easy to skip to the conclusion that your situation isn’t fixable. It’s more difficult, but honest, to remember that nothing fixes itself. Dr. Omar Suleiman explains the power Allah has given us to work to fix our problems, while always trusting Him with the best outcome. And he reminds us of the true cost of leaving our relationships broken. 0:00 - The Strangers: Those who fix what others
picks.reason: Discusses fixing life through Islamic faith, action, and trust in Allah.

picks.title: #103 - La vie pleine ou la vie bénie (Baraka édition)
picks.summary: La baraka dans le Coran, ce n'est pas une promesse d'enrichissement. Ce n'est pas non plus une affaire d'organisation ou de productivité.C'est une ouverture qu'ALLAH ﷻ réserve à ceux qui croient et font preuve de taqwa.Dans cet épisode, on parle aussi du profil de ceux qui ont perdu la baraka, du fait que ce n'était pas forcément des gens dans la misère.Un épisode qui permet de revoir ses priorités, à un moment où bien souvent, on se fixe des objectifs pour cette nouvelle année qui commence.****************************📢 OFFRE DE RENTREE : Promotions sur les formations Coran de mon coeur : ici*
